wireguard.agent.allowed-networks-hint.defaultMessage: Comma-separated CIDRs this agent may reach via the hub. Empty = full mesh (all other sites). Enforced only on this agent's own gateway, not at the hub: not a security boundary.

wireguard.agent.delete-confirm.defaultMessage: Delete agent {name}? Its token is revoked at once and the gateway is no longer managed from here. If its Freigaben filter is restricted, switch it to open first.

wireguard.agent.delete-force-confirm.defaultMessage: {name} cannot be deleted normally: its Freigaben filter is not confirmed as open, and the agent has not reported for over an hour. Delete it anyway? The gateway then keeps its last Freigaben filter (chain FG_IN) until it is removed there by hand.

wireguard.agent.ingress.applied.pending.defaultMessage: The agent has not confirmed the current ruleset yet (applies on its next poll).

wireguard.agent.ingress.applied.unknown.defaultMessage: The agent reports no filter status (agent script too old or offline) — whether the filter is active is unknown.

wireguard.agent.ingress.banner.open.defaultMessage: All traffic from the tunnel gets through.
